fields.climate: equatorial; high plateau with considerable altitude variation (772 m to 2,670 m above sea level); average annual temperature varies with altitude from 23 to 17 degrees Celsius but is generally moderate…
fields.terrain: hilly and mountainous, dropping to a plateau in east, some plains
fields.resources: nickel, uranium, rare earth oxides, peat, cobalt, copper, platinum, vanadium, arable land, hydropower, niobium, tantalum, gold, tin, tungsten, kaolin, limestone
fields.farm: cassava, bananas, sweet potatoes, beans, maize, vegetables, potatoes, rice, sugarcane, fruits
fields.exports: gold, coffee, tea, tin ores, iron bars
fields.industries: light consumer goods (sugar, shoes, soap, beer); cement, assembly of imported components; public works construction; food processing (fruits)
fields.languages: Kirundi (official), French (official), English (official, least spoken), Swahili
fields.religions: Christian 93.9% (Roman Catholic 58.6%, Protestant 35.3% [includes Adventist 2.7% and other Protestant religions 32.6%]), Muslim 3.4%, other 1.3%, none 1.3% (2016-17 est.)
fields.legal: mixed legal system of Belgian civil law and customary law
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women
